lines: I feel like someone is watching me from behind...
It feels like someone is observing me from behind...
It reeks of ambush here — I can feel it...
Too quiet — like they're waiting for my step...
I feel like something is wrong...
As if everything froze until I move...
The feeling of a gaze behind my back...
Like someone is lying in wait for me...
Too perfect a spot for an ambush...
lethalTrapThoughts: The air grew heavy... there's definitely a trap here...
I need to be more careful...
I need to pay closer attention...
